title: Create comprehensive project overview and features section
description: Write the main project introduction, overview, and features list for the README.md file
details: Create a compelling project overview that explains what codeguide is and its purpose as a full-stack web application built on the codeguide-starter template. Include a clear description of the project's goals (marketing landing page + protected dashboard). Add a comprehensive features section listing key capabilities: Hero/Features/Testimonials/Pricing/FAQ sections, authentication with better-auth, protected dashboard, dark mode support, PostgreSQL integration with Drizzle ORM, Docker setup, and SEO optimization. Use proper Markdown formatting with headers, bullet points, and emphasis where appropriate.
test_strategy: Verify the content accurately reflects the project capabilities described in the PRD. Ensure the language is clear and accessible to both technical and non-technical readers. Check that all major features from the PRD are represented.

title: Document technology stack and project structure
description: Add detailed sections covering the tech stack, architecture patterns, and project structure
details: Create a technology stack section listing all major technologies: Next.js 15 with App Router, React 18+, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, next-themes, better-auth, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Docker, and development tools. Add a project structure section explaining the key directories and files: app/ directory with routes (page.tsx, dashboard/, sign-in/, sign-up/), app/api/auth/ for authentication endpoints, components/ui/ for reusable components, and configuration files. Include brief explanations of the App Router architecture and server components approach.
test_strategy: Cross-reference the documented stack with package.json and actual project structure. Ensure all major dependencies and architectural decisions are accurately represented. Verify the structure explanation matches the actual repository layout.

title: Create detailed setup and deployment instructions
description: Write comprehensive getting started guide with step-by-step setup instructions and deployment guidance
details: Create a detailed 'Getting Started' section with numbered steps: 1) Prerequisites (Node.js 18+, PostgreSQL), 2) Clone repository command, 3) Install dependencies with npm/yarn/pnpm, 4) Environment setup (copy .env.example to .env and configure DATABASE_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, etc.), 5) Database setup and migrations, 6) Start development server command, 7) Access instructions for localhost. Add a deployment section covering environment variable requirements for production, build commands, and general hosting considerations for platforms like Vercel. Include troubleshooting tips for common setup issues like database connection problems.
test_strategy: Test all setup instructions by following them exactly in a clean environment (fresh clone). Verify each command works as expected and results in a functional development environment. Ensure environment variable examples are complete and accurate.
